curation.notes: Optical tweezers (MiniTweezers) force-ramp unfolding/refolding of Drosophila cryptochrome (dCRY, 542 aa) tethered via N-terminal biotinylated Avi tag and C-terminal ybbR-linked 350 bp digoxigenin DNA handle, as a function of FAD and FAD-moiety cofactors. Not a cell-rheology study; >150 trajectories from at least 6 molecules per condition.

evidence.snippet: Force ramp experiments were performed at a constant pulling rate of 75 nm/s sampled at 200 Hz to a maximum unfolding force of 45 pN.
